title: backup progress missing final 100% line
description: backup.rs backup_progress is called only on StepResult::More (line 94). On StepResult::Done the final count is never printed before eprintln() adds the newline. Terminal shows e.g. 900/1000 then newline then 'Backup complete' without ever displaying 1000/1000. Fix: call backup_progress(backup.progress()) before disarming the guard, or print the final count from backup.progress() after the loop exits.
